notes: 2 Critique eval cards are on this tab, one per committed run, for the same held-out video and the same artifact. Nothing on the page marks one as current. This script reads the newest by run id; a reader scrolling the tab has no such rule.

matcher reasons on screen: 0 for 3 reached criteria. The run file has why=null on every counted match, so the '↳ finding — reason' line renders without its reason. The reader can still see which finding matched, but not the matcher's argument for it. This pre-dates V7 — the run committed at HEAD has the same gap.
